cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Currently dependent on external suppliers for raw materials and certain precision components, without long-term supply agreements or fixed terms of trade with most suppliers (top 10 suppliers contributed 93.50% of purchases in FY26, 93.12% in FY25, 43.63% in FY24). IPO capex (per Objects of the Offer) is aimed at augmenting production capacity and is expected to reduce dependence on external vendors for certain precision components, with in-house production of critical components and tooling expected to improve cost efficiencies and operating margins. Company operates a business-to-business (B2B) model supplying cutting, welding and automation equipment to fabrication shops, OEMs and industrial customers across heavy fabrication/engineering, automotive/auto components, infrastructure/construction equipment, shipbuilding, steel service centres and process industries; customers span 22 states and 2 countries. Revenue from repeat orders vs. new customers: FY26 Rs.2,48,311 thousand repeat / Rs.10,64,778 thousand new customers (total Rs.13,13,090 thousand); FY25 Rs.1,36,698 thousand repeat / Rs.3,56,870 thousand new (total Rs.4,93,568 thousand); FY24 Rs.55,231 thousand repeat / Rs.5,392 thousand new (total Rs.60,623 thousand).

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Loss of any such customers or reduction in business or demand from such customers will have a significant adverse impact on our business and results of operation.
- We derive a significant portion of our revenue from sale of products from our top 10 customers.
- We may continue to remain dependent upon our key customers for a substantial portion of our revenues.
- Further, the deterioration of the financial condition or business prospects of these customers could reduce their requirement of our products and result in a significant decrease in the revenues we derive from these customers.
- In the event of our failure to retain one or more of our key customers, it will have an adverse effect on our financial performance and result of operations.
- We are dependent upon few suppliers for the material requirements of our business.
- Further, we do not have definitive agreements or fixed terms of trade with most of our suppliers.
- Failure to successfully leverage our relationships with existing suppliers or to identify new suppliers could adversely affect our business operations.
